title: Home practical guide and safety card: sound and distance
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 21 (Home practical guide and safety card: sound and distance (portal worksheet; adult present, away from roads))
intro: Lesson 21: Sound and distance: a fair test. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how distance affects how loud a sound is
equipment: A phone playing a steady sound on a low volume
A tape measure or long steps
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Work indoors or in a garden, away from roads, with an adult
Your helper holds the phone; start 1 m away
Score how loud it is (3 loud, 2 medium, 1 quiet, 0 cannot hear)
Step back to 2 m, 4 m and 8 m and score each time
Keep the volume the same: that makes it a fair test

questions.q: Sound gets ... as you move away.
Big question: why do people at the back struggle to hear?
questions.a: Sound spreads out and gets fainter with distance.
